summary: Join our Real Estate Taxation and Estate Planning Training Course to gain in-depth knowledge and practical skills for effective estate management and taxation.
lede: Real estate tax training examines how property ownership, income, transactions and transfers affect tax and estate planning. It is for professionals managing property assets or advising on finance, investment, legal or succession decisions. Participants explore ownership structures, assess tax consequences across an asset’s lifecycle, and connect wills, trusts and succession plans with property holdings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly deal with real estate assets, tax implications, or succession decisions. It targets those who need to justify real estate decisions using tax-aware and estate planning logic.
audience: Real estate portfolio managers and asset managers
Private wealth managers and family office professionals
modules: Foundations of Real Estate Taxation and Estate Planning
Understanding Real Estate Taxes Across the Asset Lifecycle
Ownership Structures and Tax Efficient Planning
Estate Planning Tools for Real Estate Assets
Valuation and Documentation for Tax and Estate Purposes
Real Estate Transactions and Their Tax Consequences
Designing Integrated Real Estate and Estate Plans
Communicating and Implementing Real Estate Estate Strategies
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of real estate transactions and some familiarity with estate planning concepts. No prior tax expertise is required, but a willingness to engage with complex scenarios is essential.
